text:
elaine (AM): quick sync — Helios Bank wants a POC eval harness for transaction-risk assistant. need: scope, golden prompts, scoring, timeline, and any enterprise blockers (security + pricing). who can own the harness setup?

mike (Solutions): I can own the harness + scoring config. Q: do they want redlines on false positives or recall prioritized?

elaine (AM): customer said FP cost is higher (customer support ops) — prefer precision. also they need PCI adjacency answers for the sec questionnaire.

shira (SE): sgtm. for precision we should weight precision 0.7 / recall 0.2 / latency 0.1 in the evaluation score. propose golden dataset: 600 labeled transactions (350 negative, 250 positive), with edge cases (multi-currency, nested chargebacks).

omar (Sales Eng): timeline constraint: they want pilot results within 6 weeks of data handoff. can we do goldens + 2 regression runs in that window?

devon (Product): 6 weeks is tight but doable if data arrives clean. recommend this schedule:
- Week 0: data ingest + label schema alignment
- Week 1: seed golden set (200) + smoke tests
- Week 2: run first eval + model selection + tuning
- Week 3-4: integration + latency profiling
- Week 5: second eval (full 600) + regression gate
- Week 6: results + handoff

violet (Customer): confirming data: we'll share a 3-month anonymized transaction slice and a mapping table. security Q: can you sign an NDA + accept our SCP restrictions?

elaine (AM): we'll route NDA to legal. sec-bot: pci-readiness-check queued — @sec-bot can you surface the specific questionnaire items we need to answer to pass their procurement gate?

sec-bot: Auto-check: required items flagged -> KMS integration, VPC peering, audit log retention (1y), data residency. See doc: https://redwood.internal/sec/pci-adjacency-guide (internal).

mike (Solutions): scoring details I propose (we'll codify in harness config):
```
scoring_rubric:
  - exact_match: 1.0
  - partial_match: 0.6
  - related_but_incorrect: 0.2
  - incorrect_or_hallucination: 0.0
weighting:
  precision: 0.7
  recall: 0.2
  latency: 0.1
regression_gate:
  - no drop > 3% absolute in weighted_score vs baseline
  - top-1 precision must be >= 85% on golden set
  - p50 latency <= 200ms on dedicated pool
```

shira (SE): golden prompt examples (CSV columns: id, prompt, expected_label, notes):
```
1, "User: I see an unexpected 2x charge from company XYZ. Is this fraud?", negative, "merchant dispute, known vendor"
2, "User: Card charged in CN while user IP was in US", positive, "geo anomaly"
3, "User: Refund processed but fee still charged", related_but_incorrect, "edge case: partial refund"
```

omar (Sales Eng): pricing Q from procurement: will pilot use Hosted API metered pricing or a time-limited Dedicated instance? they want predictable cost estimate for commit.

elaine (AM): recommend offering a 2-month trial on Dedicated with capped spend + committed discount if they convert. finance to confirm numbers.

devon (Product): operational notes: use prefix caching for repeated merchant names, batch size tuned to keep p50 under 200ms. also enable fallback model (smaller quantized) for overload testing.

mike (Solutions): ops checklist for harness delivery:
- seed golden CSV (600 rows)
- harness repo created with scorer config + eval harness pipeline (CI)
- baseline run recorded (commit hash + model id)
- regression CI job that fails on gate violations

shira (SE): can someone create the initial harness repo and add me + mike as reviewers? I'll push prompt variations and annotation guide.

omar (Sales Eng): i can create the repo from the presales template. will add a sample README and license notes for sharing with Helios.

violet (Customer): ok we'll aim to deliver data by end of next week. also sharing a prioritized list of 20 critical prompts/questions they'd like handled in pilot.

elaine (AM): action items:
- omar: create harness repo + invite SE/solutions (due: 2d)
- sec-bot/legal: surface NDA + PCI adjacency checklist (due: 3d)
- customer (violet): share anonymized dataset + prompt list (due: 7d)
- mike/shira: produce initial golden seed + scoring config (due: 10d)
- devon: confirm Dedicated trial pricing options with finance (due: 4d)

shira (SE): sgtm. one more: log a test case for hallucination detection (we want explicit failcases). I'll add a sample in the harness.

omar (Sales Eng): noted, adding that to README. rough estimate to customer for pilot cost (Dedicated capped) ~ $25k over 2 months — final after finance sign-off.

elaine (AM): thanks all. i'll follow up with a calendar invite for a kick-off once repo + NDA are in flight. :thumbsup:

mike (Solutions): ty — i'll start the scorer template tonight.

sec-bot: Reminder: include KMS key rotation policy link in the PIAs.

elaine (AM): closing thread for now; will reopen after data lands.
